title: Lima y el Callao: Guía de Arquitectura y Paisaje
lesson: Palimpsesto + itinerario: la locación importa menos que la secuencia territorial.
open_questions: Which current, primary place source verifies any derived Lima scene?
What field evidence would make the relationship legible in one frame?
expert_rejection: A published source can support a conceptual lens, but it cannot verify current scene conditions, access, safety, consent, light, activity, or one-frame strength. Its Callao coverage is outside the 43-district Lima boundary and cannot seed candidates.
